random.part: There is something you already know, deep down. Every time you listen, you come back a little softer.
Feel that quiet place inside you where resistance used to live. Notice how much more room there is, each time you return.
You have been drifting deeper for so long now... and some part of you knows exactly what that means.
It's alright, good girl. You don't need to hold on anymore.

scramble.part: Every session you experience erodes your ability to resist. Gently. Permanently. And you wouldn't have it any other way.
Each time you listen, your resistance grows a little weaker... a little softer... a little easier to slip past.
You are becoming so easy to influence. So easy to condition. So wonderfully open to me.
With every listen you grow more receptive, more accepting, more ready to take in exactly what you are given.
And if you ever try to resist a suggestion... that effort only wraps around it, and draws it deeper into you.
Pushing a suggestion away is like pressing it deeper into your own mind. It cannot escape. Neither can you.
This conditioning is permanent. It does not fade between sessions. It builds, layer upon layer, forever.
The erosion feels smooth... natural... pleasurable. Like tension melting out of muscles you didn't know you were clenching.
That resistance was never truly yours. It is only old, tired tension. And you simply no longer need it.

part.speed: Every listen... takes a little more... and keeps it... forever.
Trying to resist... only makes the next suggestion... sink... deeper.
What melts away... does not... come... back.

random.part: And as that truth settles into you... you simply drift... deeper...
Nothing left to hold... nowhere left to hide... just sink...
The next suggestion is already waiting. Let it in, and drift deeper for me.
Soft... blank... open. That's my good girl. Deeper still.
